qualitative_selection_rules.rule: Use syn-dev-01 (easy) and its registered A/B contrast in query-assignment order to explain identical evidence under two contexts and all four condition capabilities.
qualitative_selection_rules.tie_break: Not applicable: the world and query ordinals are fixed here before output inspection.

qualitative_selection_rules.rule: Choose the lexicographically first development world/context whose frozen scorer gold has a positive rare-pivotal denominator and complete support path.
qualitative_selection_rules.tie_break: Ascending world_id, then context_id, then rare-pivotal assertion anchor.

qualitative_selection_rules.rule: Choose the lexicographically first development context eligible for the frozen A-NoTemporalEpistemic probe, preferring holder-attributed evidence when eligibility ties.
qualitative_selection_rules.tie_break: Holder-attributed before temporal-only, then ascending world_id and context_id.

qualitative_selection_rules.rule: Use the easy world selected by the independent-review seed (syn-test-03), then its context at registered query ordinal A (ctx_556b0577875afcad7419). This selection does not inspect any condition output.
qualitative_selection_rules.tie_break: The review seed and ordinal-A rule are frozen; no outcome-based tie is permitted.

qualitative_selection_rules.rule: After intention-to-treat scoring, select the hard-stratum world-context with the minimum mean C2 strict qualified-assertion F1 across the two registered seeds; include invalid and timed-out outputs as registered zeros. Show C0, C1, C2, and A-FixedSelect for the selected unit regardless of which is best.
qualitative_selection_rules.tie_break: Ascending world_id, then context_id. Within the selected context, display seed blocks in registered order; never pick the worse seed post hoc.

qualitative_selection_rules.rule: After the four windows are preregistered and before condition output inspection, use the lowest registered window ordinal and both of its contexts; publish only high-level paraphrases and opaque evidence IDs.
qualitative_selection_rules.tie_break: Ascending preregistered window ordinal, then registered context ordinal.

claim_boundaries: Aggregate 12-world comparisons are confirmatory efficacy evidence; qualitative examples are illustrations only.
Development examples are pedagogical and cannot support held-out efficacy claims.
Narrative transfer is descriptive and is not pooled with the synthetic population estimate.
No result implies general LLM superiority, human usability, complete novel truth, or series-wide generalization.
Lower entropy, fewer nodes, fewer crossings, and fewer clusters are never inherently better.
Construction-freedom attribution requires the gated C2 versus A-FixedSelect mechanism result and rare-pivotal safeguards.
